description: This file defines an abstract test class for mocking UserContext within the OpenMRS testing framework, utilizing Mockito for dependency injection, and providing setup and teardown methods for mocking context-related objects in JUnit tests.

classes.name: BaseContextMockTest
classes.description: An abstract class providing mocking support for UserContext and ContextMockHelper in OpenMRS unit tests, with setup and teardown lifecycle methods.

methods.name: initMocks
methods.description: Initializes Mockito mocks for annotated fields before each test execution.

methods.name: revertContextMocks
methods.description: Reverts context mocks after each test to restore original state.
